# TruDealer — The Operating System for Independent Car Dealerships

> TruDealer (trudealers.com) is an all-in-one modular dealership platform built in Cape Town, South Africa, supporting independent dealerships globally across South Africa (ZAR), United Kingdom (GBP), Australia, and international markets.

## Key Modules & Capabilities

- **DealerAssist™ (TruChat)**: 24/7 chilled, pleasant automotive AI sales assistant. Connects live vehicle stock, calculates monthly finance instalments, pulls VIR condition reports, answers module questions, and routes qualified leads directly to WhatsApp.
- **TruLens**: 28-shot guided vehicle photo studio and 14-shot motorcycle studio on mobile with ghost wireframe overlays, automatic AI damage detection, studio light/dark background cutout, and automated 360° TruOrbit spin generation.
- **TruInspect**: 35-point condition inspection checklist, interactive visual damage tagger, dispute-proof PDF generation, digital inspector e-signatures, and 5-star graded Vehicle Inspection Reports (VIR). Includes 3-step trade-in appraisals with TransUnion live valuation lookups.
- **TruFlow DMS**: Comprehensive cloud dealer management system managing lot inventory, reconditioning expenses, sales pipeline CRM, OTP (Offer to Purchase) contracts, NATIS & roadworthy compliance, and SARS-compliant tax invoices.
- **TruOrbit**: 360° interactive exterior vehicle spin viewer.
- **TruAfford & TruRepay**: Embedded monthly finance & affordability repayment calculators with soft-pull calculations.
- **TruSocial**: Automated 1-click syndication to Facebook Marketplace, Instagram, WhatsApp, and Google Business Profile.
- **TruShowroom**: Bespoke custom dealer storefronts with 100 Web Vitals speed (e.g., true-cars.co.za).
- **TruDealer Moto**: Specialized motorcycle dealership inventory, TransUnion superbike catalogue, and 6-phase VIR.

## Pricing Tiers

- **TruStart**: R 1,599 / month (Single rooftop, unlimited stock, photo studio, inspections, AI chat, branded website). Free setup.
- **TruPro**: R 3,599 / month (Full cloud DMS + F&I, unlimited inspection templates, OTP deal jackets, live market scraper valuation, SARS tax invoicing).
